flows.title: Startup
flows.description: From process start to accepting connections

steps.note: Tokio runtime starts main(). CLI flags are parsed with clap.
Config::load merges the TOML file with TINYKV_* env vars.
Engine::open replays wal.log into a fresh MemTable so state survives restarts.
Wal::replay walks length-prefixed records, verifying each CRC.
Server binds the port and enters the accept loop, one task per socket.

flows.title: PUT request lifecycle
flows.description: How bytes on the socket become a durable write

steps.note: Conn::serve pulls a frame off the socket via the RESP codec.
The frame is decoded into Command::Put { key, val }.
Router::dispatch looks up the handler for Op::Put.
PutHandler (impl Handler) destructures the command and calls engine.put.
Under the WAL mutex: append first for durability, then insert for visibility.
The record is framed [len|crc|bytes] and fsynced according to SyncMode.
Key becomes visible to readers. Response::Ok travels back up to Conn.
